configuration_boundary.morphology: 17 DoF mobile manipulator: free base, two wheel hinges, lift slide, four coupled telescope slides, wrist yaw, gripper slide, and head pan/tilt
configuration_boundary.model_range_facts: Lift range is -0.5..0.6 m; each telescope joint is 0..0.13 m with 0..0.52 m arm-extend control range; wrist range is -1.75..4 rad; gripper slide range is -0.005..0.04 m.

source_registry.facts: Hello Robot Stretch 2 identity, 17-DoF mobile-manipulator morphology, joint ranges, body names, no explicit site, and actuator/tendon names.
Original robot and Clear BSD model provenance as recorded by Menagerie.

source_status: PUBLIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; MJCF and assets intentionally not vendored in this preparation package

tasks.description: Drive the Stretch base forward by the specified short distance and stop.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Single planar mobile-base primitive measured from the free base pose.
tasks.criterion_summary: Forward displacement is at least 0.15 m; threshold is an experimental conservative choice below the 0.20 m target.

tasks.description: Raise the Stretch lift to the specified height change and hold.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Single prismatic lift primitive using the declared joint_lift range.
tasks.criterion_summary: Lift joint displacement is at least 0.08 m; threshold is an experimental conservative choice within the -0.5..0.6 m model range.

tasks.description: Extend the Stretch telescoping arm by the specified short amount and hold.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Uses the model's coupled four-joint arm-extend tendon as one mobile-manipulator primitive.
tasks.criterion_summary: Gripper-slider Z displacement is at least 0.12 m; threshold is an experimental conservative choice within the 0..0.52 m control range.

tasks.description: Rotate the Stretch wrist to the specified small yaw change and hold.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Single wrist-yaw primitive after the mobile arm is reset.
tasks.criterion_summary: Wrist excursion is at least 0.20 rad; threshold is an experimental conservative choice within the -1.75..4 rad range.

tasks.description: Open and close the Stretch gripper once and expose the observed finger motion.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Single gripper-slide primitive with the two finger joints coupled by equality constraints.
tasks.criterion_summary: Gripper slide excursion is at least 0.01 m in each direction; threshold is an experimental conservative choice within the -0.005..0.04 m range.
